_what: The published vocabularies' version (OWL evaluation Phase 0, Doug 2026-10-13: 'Version and date'). One version for all three, /ns/meaning, /ns/structure and /ns/relation. The dated copy of each is kept forever at /ns/<name>/<date> (out/ns/versions/). Rule: a term's address never changes; a changed meaning gets a new term and the old one is deprecated. Additions bump the minor version, a change of meaning the major.

license._what: Doug, 2026-10-15: 'go with CC BY 4.0' for the vocabularies, as for the graph (2026-10-10). Granted only once the copyright filing is received: a licence that lets the public download copies publishes the work, and the filing registers it unpublished. To grant: set granted to true, give the release a new version and date, add the same two lines to ontology/meaning/meaning.ttl and ontology/claim/claim.ttl by hand (tools/ns_freeze.py refuses until they match), then run the release (docs/OPERATIONS.md, the /ns release procedure).

data._what: The graph's own version: the exports in out/export/ (claims, entities, ties, card words), apart from the vocabularies' above (the code review, 2026-10-22, B3, approved by Doug: two different builds of the claims carried the vocabulary's 1.2.0 and date, so they could not be told apart). A date-shaped version, set whenever a build is published: at the cut, and with any push that changes what an export says. tools/export_void.py writes it as the datasets' dcat:version and dcterms:modified.

graph_license._what: The graph's licence (the exports in out/export/), decided 2026-10-21 (plan 8.3a): CC BY 4.0, granted for the graph at the cut. Set granted to true on the day the public repository is published, set "repository" (top level) to its address, and rebuild the exports (tools/export_claims.py, tools/export_entities.py, tools/export_card_words.py, tools/export_ties.py, then tools/export_void.py): their headers and the VoID/DCAT description then say the licence, and each distribution names its download address. LICENSE-DATA says the same in the public repository.

_history.1.1.1: 2026-10-17: CC BY 4.0 granted, after the copyright filing was received (case 1-15283822031; application, fee and deposit on 2026-10-16). No term changed, so neither the minor nor the major version moves; 1.2.0 stays the release built from the sweep's vocabulary rulings (plan 1.35). Doug, 2026-10-17: 'prep the CC BY'
_history.1.2.0: 2026-10-21: the reviewed release (plan 8.1e; three committee sittings, 2026-10-19 and 2026-10-20): 110 terms added, none removed or deprecated (structure +46: the prepositional relations, Generic, Together, List; relation +2: spoke_to, states; meaning +18: the filter as data, CardWord, Tie, Tier and the DQV metrics and policy; claim +44: the verb statements' modality and family schemes, clause, evidencedBy). /ns/alignment (SKOS mappings) and /ns/map (the schema as pictures) begin with it. Release run prepared by Claude on 2026-10-20, dated for Doug's push
_history.1.2.1: 2026-10-22: no term added, removed or deprecated, so a patch (as 1.1.1 was). The claim vocabulary's definitions corrected to what the export does after plan 8.3f: the narrator's claims are what the text states or entails; conjectures, disputed claims and the graph's groupings are the editors', described and never stated; no bor:states triple is stated. The two shapes files and /ns/word given their rights and licence (the code review before the public repository; B4, approved by Doug: 'I approve the recommendations')
_history.1.3.0: 2026-11-01: eleven relation types added, none removed or deprecated, so a minor version: knows, loves, sees, rewards, forgives, reveals, hides, glorifies, honors, testifies_about, dwells_in (the Father's card; Doug, 2026-11-01, ruling its sheet: 'including adding the new relation words'). Definitions drafted by Claude Opus, the words approved by Doug.
_history.1.4.0: 2026-11-11: /ns/biblio, the texts vocabulary (plan 8.1g): 19 terms, LRMoo's Work, Expression and Manifestation with what the published data uses (arrangements, segments, a heading's two claim relations), and its shapes in /ns/shapes; none removed or deprecated, so a minor version. Released with the data it describes, the Psalter (out/export/psalter.nt.gz; Doug, 2026-11-06: 'release 1.4.0 together with the Psalter build'). The words drafted by Claude Opus and approved by Doug on 2026-11-06
_history.1.5.0: 2026-11-12: five verse-to-verse relation types added, none removed or deprecated, so a minor version (plan 8.7c): quotes, points_to, says_the_same_as, alludes_to, echoes, each from one biblio:Segment to another, so every verse hop the MCP makes names a term an agent can open. Split by who makes the link: the Berean editors, a judged reading, or the word match, which carries its grade (Doug, 2026-11-12: 'Six, as recommended', counted as five terms and their inverses; 'parallel account of' renamed says_the_same_as before release, since the judged pairs include a prophecy and its quotation). Definitions drafted by Claude Opus, the words and the rename approved by Doug on 2026-11-12 ('Approved')
_history.1.6.0: 2026-11-19: six relation types added and one widened, none removed or deprecated, so a minor version. camped_at, set_on and happens_to (the cards with no relation, P-2026-11-18-5: a camp on the route, a thing set on another, whom an event happens to; Doug, 2026-11-18: 'three new relations approved'); asked, removed and revealed_to, defined after 1.5.0 and published now; possibly_same_as widened from persons to beings (the adversary and Satan, 2026-11-15), and the major-theme labels reworded to say it is the map's placing (P-2026-11-18-4; Doug: 'vocab release approved'). Definitions drafted by Claude Opus and Sonnet, the types approved by Doug
_history.1.7.0: 2026-11-20: two relation types added, none removed or deprecated, so a minor version: acted_in (person, group or being to event: who does something in it, where a verse of its telling names them as the doer) and took_place_at (event to place: where a verse of its telling says it happened). Found by the event cards' conservation snapshot (P-2026-11-19-3): their casts showed 1,046 doers and 239 places no relation stated, and no type could say either. Definitions drafted by Claude Opus, the types approved by Doug on 2026-11-19 ('Approve both'); dated for the push, since 1.6.0 holds 2026-11-19
